question: Jawai Bandh is a reservoir built across Jawai River, which is a tributary of the:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Luni river.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawai Bandh is a reservoir built across Jawai River, which is a tributary of the Luni river.**
 
• The dam is near** Sumerpur town in Pali District of Rajasthan state in India.**
 
• The dam was built by **Maharaja Umaid Singh of Jodhpur. he gave idea of building a dam over River.**
 
• Jawai w conceived in 1903 as its flooding waters caused heavy damage in Pali and Jalore district during monsoon. It was finally given shape in 1946.
 
• This dam covers an** area of 13 km2**.
 
• This is the biggest man-made dam in **western Rajasthan.**
 
• The dam has a capacity of 7887.5 million cubic feet and covers an area of 102,315 acres (414.05 km2) of cultivable command area. Its height is about 61.25 feet (18.67 m).
 
• Sei dam and Kalibor dam are the feeder dams of the Jawai dam. The catchment area of the dam site is 720 square kilometres and the basin is in the shape of a fan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Banas river**
 Banas River, river in Rajasthan state, northwestern India. It rises near Kumbhalgarh and cuts its way tortuously through the Aravalli Range.
 
 

 **Chambal river**
 Chambal River, river, northern India. The Chambal is the chief tributary of the Yamuna River and rises in the Vindhya Range just south of Mhow, western Madhya Pradesh state
 
 

 **Mahi river**
 Mahi River, a stream in western India. It rises in the western Vindhya Range, just south of Sardarpur, and flows northward through Madhya Pradesh state.
